Wednesday Morning Velo

Boulder, CO · North Boulder

Wednesday Morning Velo is a road group ride in Boulder, CO. It meets every Wednesday, 6:30 am, May 20 – Sep 30, starting at Gateway Fun Park parking lot. Expect about 20–25 (Rocky Ride) and longer miles, six groups; slowest 13–15 mph.

About the Wednesday Morning Velo group ride

A big Boulder business-community ride with six pace groups and free coffee and pastries at Amante afterward. A slower 'Rocky Ride' leaves Amante at 8:30 am. Summer only.
